patch_list: Displays benefit prices and tiers (Gold, Silver, ISIC, Bronze, B2B, Basic) with active promotions and coupons in product detail screen for Czech Republic and Slovakia.
Alza Hlídač shopů Price History (CZ / SK)

Displays inline price history chart from Hlídač shopů in product detail screen for Czech Republic and Slovakia (alza.cz / alza.sk). Includes compact/large mode replacing HomeCredit installments and settings in Menu.
Alza Smart Link Sharing (FxAlza & Clean) (CZ / SK)

Enhances shared and copied Alza product links: enables fxalza.cz (or sk.fxalza.cz) domain for rich embeds on Discord and social media, and removes the 'Odesláno z aplikace Alza' promotional text. Configurable in Menu settings.
